definitions.full: H3067. Yehudith II. יְהוּדִית proper name, feminine (relation to foregoing names obscure) — wife of Esau Gen 26:34 , daughter of בְּאֵרִי the Hittite (not named 36:1 ); ᵐ5 Ιουδιν .

occurrences.englishText: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
